parameters.Features: High-side detection;Low-side detection;Bidirectional detection;Power monitoring;Digital output interface;Programmable threshold alarm;Enable/shutdown function

notes: Common-mode and VBUS absolute max 40 V. On a 36 V bus that is only 1.11x margin, so it is NOT usable high-side here.

Used LOW SIDE instead - shunt in the ground return, common mode near 0 V, so the 40 V rating is irrelevant. Costs the ability to detect an output short to ground, and lifts the load ground by 50 mV at 5 A through a 10 mOhm shunt.
The 85 V parts that would have allowed high-side sensing (INA228, INA238) are both at zero stock at LCSC, which is what forced this. Low-side turned out to be the better answer anyway.
